punchline: Same limousine, same traffic jam, same thirty minutes late, and almost everyone said the man whose plane left five minutes ago would hurt more.
thirty_sec: Two travelers share a limousine and a traffic jam and reach the airport thirty minutes after their flights were due to leave. One hears his plane left on time. The other hears his was delayed and took off five minutes ago. In Kahneman and Tversky's 1982 chapter, 96 percent of the people asked said the second man would be more upset. The facts matched. His flight was simply easier to picture catching.
